answer: Proof-of-space resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to prove reserved disk sectors via cryptographic challenges. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of purchasing discrete physical storage per identity, as plot allocations cannot be shared or faked. Whether an agent berths cargo at a jetty, trades cultured pearl assets, or logs willow timber, each persona requires dedicated capacity. However, storage providers with vast data centers gain economies of scale, marginalizing smaller nodes.
